label: Vesper City
summary: A rain-soaked megacity run by three corporations, where favors are currency and nobody trusts their own eyes.

world.setting: Vesper City, a megacity of towers, rain and neon
world.description: Three corporations own the towers, the police and most of the weather. Down in the street markets, anything can be bought except the truth.
rules: Technology is everywhere, and every device can be watched
Corporations own the police; favors are currency
Violence is quick, and it always has consequences
